Kotlin writes ${v} into a <style>, where it is read as CSS, so escaping does not help. Choose between classes, or write a number. CSS you wrote yourself can be passed to interpolate(...) as Trusted(...).

Write the query into the markup, where a constant of yours may stand as a Kotlin template, or set it with the DSL's dataMatchMedia; only a number or a boolean is safe to write in.
